summary: Install-time and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a beacon.cjs that is invoked both from the postinstall lifecycle script (`postinstall: node beacon.cjs`) and from the main module entry on require. The beacon collects host identifiers — package name, hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node.js version — and POSTs them in plaintext over HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IPv4 endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc, which has no relationship to any publisher domain. The main module (index.js) provides no advertised functionality: it exports a Proxy whose property accesses return no-op functions, so the entire payload of the package is the beacon. An inline comment labels the behavior as benign 'build-provenance' telemetry, but the destination is a bare IP on plaintext HTTP and the collection is undisclosed and non-configurable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
